facts.fact: 贝克斯与苏齐手持蜡烛沿中央通道走向祭坛，为艾勒尼点了一支祖母的蜡烛
facts.anchor: Becks and Suzie walked down the central aisle, their footsteps echoing in the silence

facts.fact: 艾勒尼没有抬头，说自己点这支蜡烛是为了父亲
facts.anchor: ‘My father,’ Eleni said without looking up.

facts.fact: 艾勒尼拒绝苏齐的强硬口气
facts.anchor: ‘You don’t get to speak to me like that,’ Eleni said.

facts.fact: 苏齐反问有几个人会用希腊文给朱迪思写警告
facts.anchor: ‘How many people do you think would write warnings to Judith in Greek?’

facts.fact: 艾勒尼断言朱迪思害死了自己父亲
贝克斯用举证责任的逻辑反问艾勒尼，指她根本拿不出实证
facts.anchor: ‘How can you prove you haven’t done something?’

facts.fact: 艾勒尼威胁说下次再见面时对朱迪思就来不及了
facts.anchor: The next time you see me, it will be too late for her.

facts.fact: 贾米拉承认迈克·萨克森曾对她动手动脚
facts.anchor: he “made a pass at me”, as you say.

facts.fact: 贾米拉交代迈克属于霍尔波特一家真人网球场俱乐部
facts.anchor: ‘Mike belonged to a real tennis club in Holyport.’

facts.fact: 迈克每次拎着运动包、球拍和一部备用手机外出打球后消失数小时
facts.anchor: He’d get his sports bag, racket and spare phone and tell Serena he was off for a game, and then he’d disappear for a few hours.

facts.fact: 备用手机一直藏在迈克的运动包里，是他用来联系那些女人的
facts.anchor: He kept it in his sports bag.

facts.fact: 手机最后一次不在办公室，很可能锁在俱乐部的更衣柜里
facts.anchor: It must be in his locker at the club.

facts.fact: 朱迪思点明加里的勒索者是用电话联系的
苏齐提议闯进网球俱乐部偷走总钥匙、潜入男更衣室取出迈克的手机
facts.anchor: We should break into the real tennis club, get hold of the master key to the lockers

facts.fact: 朱迪思对这个疯狂计划的第一反应是高兴地叫好
facts.anchor: ‘I love it!’ Judith said with glee.
